legal.about.title: About us
legal.about.p1: AUTOMANQANEBI.GE is Georgia's online car marketplace connecting buyers and sellers.
legal.about.p2: Our goal is to make buying and selling cars simple, transparent, and safe.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.privacy.p1: We collect only data needed for your account and listings (email, name, phone).
legal.privacy.p2: Data is not sold to third parties and is stored on secure Firebase infrastructure.
legal.privacy.p4: Cookies: we use essential and analytics cookies to improve the experience.
legal.privacy.p5: Payments: VIP and bump orders are stored as records; card processing is via a bank provider.
legal.terms.title: Terms of service
legal.terms.p1: Sellers are responsible for the accuracy of their listings.
legal.terms.p2: The platform is not a party to transactions between buyers and sellers.
legal.terms.p3: False or misleading listings are prohibited.
legal.terms.p4: Paid services (VIP, bump) activate after successful payment.
legal.cookies.title: Cookie Policy
legal.cookies.p1: We use essential cookies for auth and preferences.
legal.cookies.p2: Analytics helps us improve traffic. You can restrict cookies in your browser.
